exposure: Implementation of new labor management guidelines
changing clinical practices of doctors and paramedical staff
outcome: vaginal birth after caesarean section rates
cohort: All patients delivering at Al Nafees Medical College Hospital between January 2012 and January 2017.
finding: The implementation of guidelines and changed practices safely reduced overall and primary caesarean section rates without increasing fetal or neonatal morbidity or mortality.
mod_finding: Overall and primary caesarean section rates decreased, while vaginal birth after caesarean section rates increased, following the implementation of guidelines and practice changes.
